COD.note: Mentions a plan to connect 90 percent by 2050 and a ministry intention to explore connecting isolated localities; no delivered programme and no rural/urban figures.
Discusses sovereignty in general and a subscriber-ID licence condition; no state-data rule, hosting or contract data terms stated.
Plan named only as a source for targets; standing, text and scope not described.

systems.system: Document de Politique sectorielle (DPS) des télécommunications

COD.note: Says the DRC 'a élaboré' a sector policy document since 2009; adoption not stated.
Figure is a penetration rate from old sources, not ownership of people for 2024 or later.
Author is at the Catholic University of Bukavu but the document states no institution researching digital policy as a programme; a single analysis only.

facts.fact: The ARPTC regulator's communiqué of 2 May 2025 granted Starlink DRC a telecommunications network and services licence, per the author.
